response.overview: A new high school student struggles to hide her alien identity when every word she speaks reveals her true form bit-by-bit. How long can she keep her true self secret?  To Alien Girl, Tagalog feels like an alien language and her lack of understanding towards it is what makes her feel more ‘alienated’ from her peers. She attempts to survive the school day when her worst fear comes true: forced recitation. Oh the humanity!
